description: This file implements the DataParallel class and associated functions for parallelizing neural network modules across multiple GPUs within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: DataParallel
classes.description: A PyTorch Module subclass that implements data parallelism at the module level by splitting inputs across GPUs, replicating the module, and gathering outputs.

methods.name: None _check_balance(device_ids: Sequence[int | torch.device])
methods.description: Checks for imbalance between GPUs based on memory and processor count, issuing warnings if necessary.

methods.name: None __init__( self, module: T, device_ids: Sequence[int | torch.device] | None = None, output_device: int | torch.device | None = None, dim: int = 0, )
methods.description: Initializes a DataParallel instance, setting up device IDs, output device, and performing balance checks.

methods.name: Any forward(self, *inputs: Any, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Executes the forward pass by scattering inputs to devices, replicating the module, and gathering outputs.

methods.name: list[T] replicate(self, module: T, device_ids: Sequence[int | torch.device])
methods.description: Replicates the module to specified devices, handling gradient requirements.

methods.name: Any scatter( self, inputs: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None, device_ids: Sequence[int | torch.device], )
methods.description: Splits inputs and distributes them across specified devices.

methods.name: list[Any] parallel_apply( self, replicas: Sequence[T], inputs: Sequence[Any], kwargs: Any )
methods.description: Applies the replicated modules to scattered inputs in parallel.

methods.name: Any gather(self, outputs: Any, output_device: int | torch.device)
methods.description: Collects outputs from multiple devices into a single tensor.

methods.name: torch.Tensor data_parallel( module: Module, inputs: Any, device_ids: Sequence[int | torch.device] | None = None, output_device: int | torch.device | None = None, dim: int = 0, module_kwargs: Any | None = None, )
